license: CC BY 4.0 (OpenStax Biology 2e); snapshot kept local only
kind: textbook page with labeled medical illustrations (transparent-background WebP), long alt text and numbered figure captions

requiredButtons.labelSource: figure number and caption from <figcaption>; the long alt text (a full description) is offered as the image's description, not crammed into the button label

tactile.coordinateSpace: source pixels [x0, y0, x1, y1]; tolerance 30 px
tactile.preprocess: the image has a transparent background and black label text: composite onto WHITE before sending to the model or tracing (on black, all labels vanish)

shapes: panel (a): heart cross-section outline with the four chambers, septum and the great vessels on top
the inset: a small rectangle on the heart wall and an arrow to a magnified block showing wall layers as parallel bands
panel (b): the outside of the heart as an outline with the coronary vessels as branching lines
drop: label text and leader lines (labels become components)
colour (outline only; red/blue named in labels)

isolatePanelA.expect: chambers, valves and vessels as separate outlined regions; fill <= 0.25

isolateInset.expect: the wall layers as 3-4 parallel bands, each a touch region with its label

components.label: (a) Parts of the heart: chambers, valves and great vessels
(b) Coronary arteries and veins on the surface of the heart

componentChecks: children are labelled from the figure's own printed labels (after white compositing), matched to shapes by their leader lines
the inset is linked to the small rectangle on the heart wall it magnifies (description or relation)
same anatomy as wikipedia-heart: labels should agree across the two cases

tree.action: group the four valves under a new component 'Valves'
tree.expect: Enter on Valves lists all four

pins.action: draw the path of blood through the right side
